A prayer which creates {{Item|Blessing of commerce}}, used to directly improve vendor tiers. It can be crafted at the [[Desk]] or [[Desk II]]. The quality is dependent on the ingredients and for the sermon to be successful the church needs a rating of 10{{Church Rating}}/20{{Church Rating}}/30{{Church Rating}}.
